name: Australia
intro: Explore a continent of ancient wonders, massive coral reefs, and laid-back coastal cities. Australia is a playground of natural beauty, outdoor adventure, and diverse wildlife.
bestSeason: September to November (Spring) & March to May (Autumn)
weather: Varies by region. Tropical warm climate in the north, temperate seasons in the south. Summer runs from December to February.
visaInfo: Electronic Travel Authority (ETA) or tourist visa required for visitors prior to arrival.
flightDuration: Approx 12-14 hours one-stop flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Fly over the vibrant coral chains of the Great Barrier Reef
Watch the sunset paint the giant sandstone dome of Uluru
Sail a private catamaran under the Sydney Harbour Bridge
Drive the spectacular ocean route of the Great Ocean Road

famousPlaces.name: Sydney Harbour
famousPlaces.shortDesc: Australia's largest city, famous for the sails of the Opera House and the massive steel Harbour Bridge.
famousPlaces.overview: Sydney combines a spectacular harbor, sandy beaches, and national park loops. Take a private catamaran tour under the bridge, walk the coastal paths from Bondi to Coogee, and dine at the Opera House.
famousPlaces.bestTimeToVisit: September to November, March to May

hotels.name: Park Hyatt Sydney
hotels.description: Luxury hotel set directly on the harbor waters looking towards the Opera House.

famousPlaces.meals: Fresh harbor seafood dinners and organic Aussie breakfasts.
famousPlaces.transport: Private chauffeur transfers and private yacht charters.
famousPlaces.activities: Opera House Behind-the-scenes Tour, Sydney Bridge Climb, Bondi Beach Surf Lesson.
included: Opera House VIP tour access tickets

faqs.q: Can we climb the Harbour Bridge?
faqs.a: Yes, we include safety harnesses and professional climb leaders to take you to the summit.

reviews.author: Mark W.
reviews.text: Climbing the Harbour Bridge at twilight was incredible. The Opera House sails look stunning from the water.

itinerary.title: Harbour Arrival & Sunset Cruise
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup, check into Park Hyatt. Rest.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll the historic Royal Botanic Gardens.
itinerary.evening: Private catamaran cruise with dinner and views of the harbor.

itinerary.title: Opera House & Bridge Climb
itinerary.morning: VIP behind-the-scenes tour of the Opera House.
itinerary.afternoon: Guided BridgeClimb to the top of Sydney Harbour Bridge.
itinerary.evening: Gourmet dining at a waterfront restaurant in Circular Quay.
